deskNote: Most Power 4 TV contracts are conference deals, not 68 school contracts. Dollars and through-years appear only with a named source. Empty means pending — not zero.

SEC.name: SEC
SEC.splitLabel: Equal share among full members; Texas and Oklahoma are on a cited phase-in, not a full share.
SEC.notes: SBJ and Sports Media Watch cite a 10-year ESPN package at $710M a year / $7.1B starting 2024 (CBS left after 2023). That is the conference rights fee, not a school contract and not the full SEC distribution (CFP, bowls, NCAA sit on top). Business of College Sports still frames per-school off the 14 members at signing (~$50.7M). This desk uses current 16: $710M / 16. Texas and Oklahoma do not get that estimate.

Big Ten.name: Big Ten
Big Ten.splitLabel: Generally equal among full-share members. USC and UCLA booked as full shares. Oregon and Washington are on cited reduced / half shares through about 2030.
Big Ten.notes: SBJ: FOX/CBS/NBC, seven years, $8.05B / $1.15B a year, through FY 2029-30. Peacock is the streaming home. The $1.15B is the rights fee, not the FY2025 $1.37B total distribution (that figure mixes media, CFP, and other conference revenue). SBJ originally framed per-school off 16 members with USC/UCLA. Oregon and Washington later joined on reduced shares; this desk naive equal-share is $1.15B / 18 and is labeled estimated. Those two schools do not get it.

sources.label: Sports Business Journal — Big Ten FOX/CBS/NBC deals
Sports Media Watch — sports media rights list
Big Ten — record $1.37B FY2025 distribution (first full year of current rights + 18 members)
CBS Sports — FY2025 payouts; Oregon/Washington partial shares through 2030

ACC.name: ACC
ACC.annualLabel: Base ESPN AAV vs FY2025 TV receipts
ACC.splitLabel: Not equal. 2025 FSU/Clemson settlement: 40% of base media rights shared equally; 60% by five-year weighted football (75%) and mens basketball (25%) viewership. Cal and Stanford take partial TV shares. SMU forgoes TV money in early membership years. Grant of Rights / exit fees were rewritten; we do not flatten this to equal share.
ACC.notes: The $240M / $4.8B / through-2036 figures are the long-cited 2016 ESPN base deal (SBJ table; FOS 2024). ESPN exercised its option in January 2025 so the partnership runs through 2036 (without that option it ended after 2027). WRAL, from FY2025 tax documents, reports $588.8M in conference television receipts — base rights plus ACC Network and expansion markets, not the same number as the 2016 AAV. Both are shown. No public per-school media-only breakdown for legacy members; we do not mint one.

Big 12.name: Big 12
Big 12.splitLabel: Equal media share among the 12 members at signing (ESPN: $380M / 12 ~ $31.7M). A pro-rata clause pays more to the conference if Power schools are added, so Arizona, Arizona State, Colorado, and Utah should not dilute that per-school media figure. The expanded conference pot is not independently cited on this desk.
Big 12.notes: ESPN and The Athletic: six-year extension, $2.28B / $380M a year, ESPN >60% of inventory, through 2030-31. Third-tier school rights end under this deal. Some recaps float ~$505M after the four Pac-12 additions; we could not lock that dollar to a newsroom primary, so the expanded pot stays pending. Per-school media uses the cited $380M / 12 formula, not $380M / 16.

deals.name: NBC football
deals.notes: The real school-level exception. Official terms were not disclosed. NBC and Notre Dame announced a multi-year extension through 2029 (home games on NBC/Peacock). Front Office Sports: about double the prior low-$20M tax-return run-rate, somewhere in the $50 million range. Sportico: believed in keeping with Big Ten FY2022 payouts of $58.8M. The Athletic (2024): reports around $50M a year. Shown as an estimated $50-59M range, not a filing.

cfp.name: College Football Playoff
cfp.termLabel: New six-year grant starts 2026-27 through 2031-32; remaining two years of the prior deal cover 2024-25 and 2025-26
cfp.notes: One national package, not 68 school deals. AP: $7.8B / $1.3B a year for the six-year extension; championship moves to ABC in 2026. Official CFP/ESPN releases confirm exclusivity through 2031-32 and do not print the dollar — the dollar is the AP / Athletic figure. First-round games in 2024-25 and 2025-26 were added onto the old contract. We do not copy this pot onto every school card.
